name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. After a stint in the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, where he specialized in high-profile event security, he found the roar of engines more appealing than the quiet of parliamentary grounds. His transition to motorsport was seamless, bringing with him a rigorous approach to risk assessment and mitigation. 

Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous planning and unwavering commitment to safety. He believes in proactive security measures, constantly seeking innovative solutions to potential threats. His demanding nature stems from a deep sense of responsibility for the well-being of the team and ensuring the integrity of the competition. He's particularly focused on cyber security vulnerabilities within the increasingly digital world of racing.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a stern gaze that exudes authority.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting security protocols.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on performing a personal security sweep of the team garage before each race.
